description.value: Oretachi Curry is the Canadian outpost of an Osaka, Japan original, serving authentic Japanese curry rice and a signature curry ramen built on a house-made shrimp oil and ebi miso broth. Every order gets a freshly panko-fried katsu made in-house, and the curry blend draws on over 20 spices with locally sourced BC ingredients. The restaurant sits in the Riley Park stretch of Main Street, one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors, and offers online ordering and takeout for riders on the move.
